title: How to Research Your Career Options
description:
In this @teal_hq class, we'll take a look at how to research career options and think about how you fit in organizations, which are the context in which our careers can flourish. 

Here’s what we’ll touch on: 

1. Our approach how we think about it, and some of the key terms and frameworks that we're using.
2. Activities within the organization. How does work get organized at different types of companies? That context is going to change how that work gets deployed.
3. Functions and industries, which are going to be the groupings of either activities or categories of service—which, again, will affect the kind of work that we do and will align to our values and interests 
4. How to find your fit—how to merge those things about yourself with the place you want to go. 

00:00 | Introduction
01:17 | Our approach and how we think about career options (+key terms and frameworks)
04:15 | Activities within the organization 
09:00 | How does work get organized at different companies?
13:01 | Functions and industries (the groupings of either activities or categories of service)
26:43 | How to find your fit—are you a generalist or specialist?
37:59 | Wrapping up & conclusions


The intention here is to identify your ideal fit within an organization, function, and industry so it can give you that fulfilling and exciting work.
